Selective-foresight filter over world-model predictions, compared against other world-model baselines on prediction accuracy and not only downstream success; lookahead iteration policy.

City-navigation agentic workflow with reflection memory; the claim is improved navigation performance over baselines, a domain outcome.

eVTOL flight-planning system with RAG memory and coach agent; claims are plan validity rates and operator-preference metrics.
MARL subgoal decomposition prompted from a language model; claims are sample efficiency and performance on Overcooked and MiniRTS.
